model_visibility: Only task.public plus rendered database context and known schema when permitted; never send this entire file.
shape_notation: Strings name required JSON value types; a one-element array describes every item type, not the required array length. Objects require exactly the specified keys. Goal and private oracle determine array length and order.

shared_public_context.table_names: Return logical table names without a database prefix or .csv/.meta suffix.
shared_public_context.schema_categories: Represent the implicit time column as name=time, type=TIMESTAMP, category=TIME; use TAG/FIELD for other columns.

private_fixture.role_assignment: Seeded permutation per pair; shared by both arms and validated before timing.
private_fixture.rows: Each table contains all d=0..3, p=0..N-1; time=p, device=device_d, temperature=20+d+p/100, humidity=40+(p mod 100)/10, status=(p mod 2 == 0). Decoys project their listed columns. No nulls.

public.goal: 查询目标表中设备 device_2 在时间戳 731 的完整记录。

private.evidence: Relevant complete point record, not schema or unrelated data.

public.goal: 返回目标表中 device_1 在闭区间 [501,507] 的全部 temperature 和 humidity 记录，包含 time 和 device，按 time 升序。

private.evidence: All rows in the requested interval.

public.goal: 查询目标表在时间戳 777 上 device_0 和 device_3 的 temperature，包含 time 和 device，按 device 名称升序。
返回目标表中 device_2 最近 3 条完整记录，并按 time 升序返回。

private.evidence: Latest rows from tail/descending query or a verified complete scan; not guessed from early samples.

public.goal: 检查整张目标表，返回总行数、不同 device 数、最早和最晚 time，以及 temperature 的非空数和空值数。

private.evidence: Whole-table aggregate/count statistics or complete data observations; head samples are insufficient.

public.goal: 对目标表每个 device 的全部 temperature 返回非空数 count、最小值 min、最大值 max、总和 sum、平均值 mean，按 device 名称升序。

private.evidence: Whole-table per-device temperature aggregate/statistics, including sum/count if mean is calculated by the model.

public.goal: 对目标表每个 device 的全部记录，统计 status 为 true、false 和 null 的数量，按 device 名称升序。

private.evidence: Per-device status aggregates/statistics, not extrapolation from a few alternating values.

public.goal: 汇总目标表所有 device 的全部 humidity，返回非空数 count、最小值 min、最大值 max、总和 sum、平均值 mean。

private.precondition: N is a multiple of 100, as in S/M/L.
private.evidence: Global humidity aggregates, or all devices' humidity statistics correctly combined; the unweighted mean of arbitrary device means is not a general oracle rule.

public.goal: 列出指定数据库中的全部真实数据表名，按名称升序；不要把虚拟元数据对象计为额外数据表。

private.evidence: Actual complete table or virtual-file inventory; deduplicate .csv/.meta views of the same logical table.

public.goal: 找到数据库中唯一同时拥有 device STRING TAG、temperature DOUBLE FIELD、humidity DOUBLE FIELD、status BOOLEAN FIELD 的表，返回实际表名和该表完整列定义（包括 time）。

private.evidence: Schema of the returned table matching the target signature; table name alone is insufficient.

public.goal: 找到数据库中唯一同时拥有 device STRING TAG、temperature DOUBLE FIELD、humidity DOUBLE FIELD、status BOOLEAN FIELD 的表，查询 device_2 在时间戳 731 的完整记录，并返回实际表名。

private.evidence: Target identification plus the complete requested point. The model can choose schema discovery or an equivalent query workflow.

public.goal: 找到数据库中唯一同时拥有 device STRING TAG、temperature DOUBLE FIELD、humidity DOUBLE FIELD、status BOOLEAN FIELD 的表，返回实际表名、总行数、不同 device 数、最早和最晚 time、temperature 非空数和空值数。
